name: QGroup House Data Centre
notes: State House presidential statement says QGroup House contains The Gambia's first Data Centre and launched QCell Fibre services; DCD reports the facility is on Kairaba Avenue and that capacity details were not disclosed. Classified to Western because Kanifing/Serekunda is not a separate batch division.

name: National Data Centre and National Identity Management System
developer: Government of The Gambia / Ministry of Interior / Margins ID Systems Applications Ltd.
notes: Reporting says President Adama Barrow inaugurated The Gambia's National Data Centre in Abuko and launched NIMS, implemented as a PPP between the government and Margins ID Systems Applications Ltd. Classified to Western because Abuko/Kanifing is not a separate batch division.

name: Gamtel Kairaba Exchange Data Center
notes: Inflect lists Gamtel Kairaba Exchange as a data center on Kairaba Avenue in Serekunda with 400 kVA power infrastructure, N+1 cooling, security, and fiber connectivity; Datacenters.com also lists the facility. Classified to Western because Kanifing/Serekunda is not a separate batch division.

name: MRC Unit The Gambia Data Centre, Fajara
developer: Medical Research Council Unit The Gambia at LSHTM
notes: LSHTM official news says MRC Unit The Gambia at LSHTM inaugurated a new Data Center at its Fajara site on 2018-07-16 to support research computing, storage, and applications. Classified to Western because Fajara/Kanifing is not a separate batch division.
